name: Giving To The Needy
overview: Scripture teaches that giving to the needy is an act of righteousness that pleases God and results in blessing both for the giver and the receiver. The generous who share their resources with the poor are likened to lending to the Lord Himself and will be rewarded accordingly. Believers are cautioned to give discreetly, not for human recognition, but with a sincere heart before God. Moreover, giving is portrayed as a source of joy and spiritual blessing, emphasizing that it is more blessed to give than to receive and that God delights in such sacrifices.
